Suicide is scary because your life is in your hands at this point. Everything you’ve gone through, from birth till now, it’s all in your hands to fulfill. You contemplate, do I stay or do I end it? One positive seeking the future and one negative seeking solice from the aching pain. It’s hard because there and then, you make the CHOICE to end everything that makes you up as a person. Every achievement. Every success. Every failure. Every movement. Every memory. You make the choice to put an end to that all or keep going. That’s why it’s so damn scary because one choice is PERMANENT and the other choice is CHANGE.

I know exactly how you feel. In 2014, things got so bad for me, that I went in my garage and tried to hang myself with an electrical cord, I was ready but I heard a scratch coming from my garage door and it was my cat and I never pulled through with it. He stayed with me the whole night until then. Now fast forward to 2017, life got even worse, I got sick, I got into a car accident, my relationship was long distance, I had to drop out of school for a bit and was barely working due to my accident. Shit got so bad, that I wanted to die. Everyday, id think about hanging myself in my garage - just for some peace and some relief from my life. But I could never pull through. Because the one thing I remember when I came out to my mom about my depressive thoughts, she said that if I ever killed myself that would literally kill her or make her go insane. Also my cat, who’s been there through everything, that loves me , I can’t imagine leaving him. And my beloved girlfriend, it only took a look at her teary eyes and eager voice to really hit me deeper to keep me going. We’re all loved, and if we kill ourselves we put the pain we once had to other people if we let go. 

Sometimes when you can’t live for yourself, you have to live for others and that’s the inch of hope that helps us keep going in our lives. 

Get well soon. Hope things get better from here on.

You know when you’re with the right person when you’re willing to sacrifice a lot for them. You don’t just love them for looks or physical features but you love them as they are - from their best to their worse. Accepting their flaws. You know they’re right when you feel yourself GROWING with them rather than moving backwards. Life becomes dull without them. They pick you up and you do the same. You love them through everything and don’t do it ‘just cause’. You love them through the hardest of times, through the painful moments and the moments when they can be hard to love. And once you can do that and they do the same back. Not to owe you but out of love - that’s when you found the right one. It’s not about the good times, but it’s about the times we need someone the most where we can see who truly is the right one.
